description: Checks smoke fails in owners-shared mode; labels-off it fails none.

categories.reason: Owner mode, like a label scheme, keeps persistence off, and the wrapper sets save to "" and appendonly to no so the server can start. SAVE, BGSAVE, BGREWRITEAOF, DUMP, RESTORE, MIGRATE, DEBUG RELOAD, DEBUG LOADAOF and SHUTDOWN SAVE answer the persistence error, CONFIG SET of save points or appendonly yes is refused and CONFIG GET and CONFIG REWRITE show save "", so the persistence, append-only file, migrate, dump, corrupt payload and storage sections differ, SAVE inside MULTI answers the persistence error before the transaction's own refusal, MONITOR does not show the refused MIGRATE commands, the vector set cases built on a restored set differ, and the keys the refused RESTOREs of the dump cases would have left change the DBSIZE that the watch expiry transaction reads. The corrupt payload and dump families are patterns because their case names carry generated payloads; every case in them sends RESTORE.

categories.reason: ACL SETUSER <login> reset also clears the clearance, trust and owner rules, the operator scope included. The ACL scenarios restore the default login with ACL SETUSER default reset on nopass ~* &* +@all, so from then on the default login runs at the lowest label without the operator scope, and the counters scenario's CONFIG RESETSTAT is refused as a top-only command. The function scenario runs after them, so its FUNCTION LOAD, DELETE, FLUSH and RESTORE, which change stored functions and need the operator at a top label (see docs/owners.md#the-operator-and-top), are refused with the top-only error before their own argument errors.

categories.reason: Owner mode turns the label machinery on, so the server keeps the watched keys of a transaction that a write has marked until the watches are cleared, adds the keys of a WATCH sent after the mark and keeps queueing the commands of a marked transaction, so that the watch count, the transaction fields and the client memory of a connection do not depend on whether a watched key was written; the 7.4 server forgets the keys, ignores the WATCH and stops queueing. The introspection scenario writes keys its connections watch and then reads the watch, multi and multi-mem fields of CLIENT LIST and the watching_clients and total_watched_keys of INFO, which therefore differ after each such write.
